SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No.........
S.1, Special Branch, XXXXX,
REPORT
Date October 20, 1937.
Subject Transportation of Cotton from Pootung to the Settlement
Made by C.D.I. Sih Tse-liang Forwarded by [Signature]

With reference to the remarks of D.C. (Special Branch),
enquiries have been made at the office of the Cotton
Transportation and Sales Society of Pootung, and it has been
ascertained from Mr. Chu Wen-teh (朱文德), Chief of the
General Affairs Department of the Society, that the cotton
which the Society intends dealing in is raw cotton which
will be collected in the Pootung area, packed in straw bags
and not that pressed into bales.
It is learned that the cotton so collected will first
be transported across the Whangpoo to the Nantao Bund and
then conveyed by trucks through the French Concession to the
Pootung Guild, 1454 Avenue Edward VII, where the office of
the Society is located, and will be temporarily stored there
pending arrangements being completed for godown storage.
The staff of the Society has not so far intimated
their intention of using the Bund of the International
Settlement for such unloading, although the use of the Bund
of the French Concession is under negotiation with the
French Authorities.
The Society has received a number of requests from
farmers in villages situated in the western suburbs of
Shanghai, requesting that the scheme be applied to them also,
and these requests are being studied by the Society, and
have tentatively agreed to purchase their cotton in the same
manner as that in Pootung on the condition that the farmers
themselves be responsible for the transportation of cotton
to the offices of the Society.
This raw cotton will no doubt enter the International
Settlement through the Western Boundary, either by Sicawei

日期：1937年10月20日。
事由：从浦东向租界运输棉花
由 C.D.I. Sih Tse-liang（音译）呈报 转呈人 [签名]

鉴于特务科副主管的批注，已向浦东棉花运销社办事处进行查询，并从该社总务部主任朱文德先生处获悉，该社拟经营的棉花为原棉，将在浦东地区收集，装入草袋包装，而非打包成棉包。
据悉，如此收集的棉花将首先横渡黄浦江运至南市外滩，随后通过卡车经法租界运至爱多亚路1454号的浦东同乡会，该社办事处即设于此地；在仓库存储安排完成之前，棉花将暂时存放于此。
截至目前，该社职员尚未表示有意利用公共租界外滩进行此类卸货作业，尽管其正就利用法租界外滩一事与法国当局进行协商。
该社已收到若干来自上海西郊村庄农民的请求，希望将该方案也适用于他们；该社正在研究这些请求，并已初步同意以与浦东相同的方式收购他们的棉花，条件是农民自行负责将棉花运送至该社办事处。
这批原棉无疑将通过西界进入公共租界，要么经由徐家汇

Should a larger quantity of raw cotton be collected,

The Society is at present making arrangements to

POLICE
Dated 11th October, 1937.
No. P 2900 / 464
10 / 10 /
Footung Cotton
The fields in Footung are mostly planted with cotton. Owing
to the difficulty of transportation caused by the local hostilit-
ies, the cotton now harvested by the farmers in Footung is not
being purchased. To afford relief the Footung Residents'
Association has raised a fund of $1,000,000 and requested cotton
and cotton-yarn dealers as well as Footung Residents in Shanghai
to organize the under-mentioned Association, whose functions it
will be to devise measures to facilitate the transportation, sale,
mortgage and storage of cotton, and to regulate the price.
An office has been established on the 5th floor of the Footung
Residents' Association premises and work has been commenced. We
shall be very grateful if the Council would kindly instruct the
Police to permit boats and trucks employed by us for transporting
cotton to pass freely and also to afford them protection.
(Signed & Chopped) Association for Transportation
& Sale of Cotton Produced in Footung.
Tu Yueh-seng, Chairman
Wong Zeng-tsz & 3 Others
Members of Standing Committee.
Encls: 2 specimens each of Banners & Certificates
(Note: Received for translation a.m. 14th Oct. 1937.)
REFERRED TO POLICE FORCE
FOR THE NECESSARY ACTION DIRECT
LB

浦东棉花产销运输协会
（會協銷運花棉東浦）
致工部局信函译文

警务处
日期：1937年10月11日
编号：P 2900 / 464
10 / 10 /

浦东棉花

浦东地区田地多植棉花。因当地战事导致运输困难，浦东农户目前收获的棉花无人收购。为提供救济，浦东居民协会已筹集资金一百万元，并邀请棉商、纱商以及在上海的浦东居民组织下述协会，其职能在于制定措施，以便利棉花的运输、销售、抵押及储存，并调节价格。

办事处已设于浦东居民协会会所五楼，并开始工作。如工部局能指令警务处准许我方用于运输棉花的船只和卡车自由通行，并给予保护，我们将不胜感激。

（签名及盖章）浦东棉花产销运输协会
主席：杜月笙
常务委员：黄增兹及其他三人

附件：旗帜及证书样本各两件
（注：1937年10月14日上午收到待译。）

转交警务处
采取必要行动
LB
1937年10月15日
（印：1937年10月23日）

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No............
S.1. Special Branch
REPORT
Date: October 14, 1937
Subject Cotton Transportation and Sales Society of Pootung.
Made by C.D.I. Sih Tse-liang Forwarded by....................

The Cotton Transportation and Sales Society of Pootung
which was formally inaugurated on October 3, 1937 (Vide attached
extract from Daily Intelligence Report dated 4/10/37) has an
office in the Pootung Guild, 1454 Avenue Edward VII. This
Society has as its main object the regulation of the sales
of cotton collected by the farmers from their fields in Pootung
area. The demand for this commodity, it is to be noted, has
fallen off considerably owing to the present hostilities, with
the result that the livelihood of the farming people in Pootung
has been seriously affected.
The Society decided to raise $1,000,000.00 as capital which
will be divided into 1,000 shares of $1,000.00 each, and up
to the present, $800,000.00 of this amount has been subscribed
by its members, who number about thirty, all being either cotton
merchants or gentry of Pootung.
The following persons are on the Standing Committee :-
Mr. Tu Yueh Sung(杜月笙), Chairman of the Shanghai Citizens'
Association.
Mr. Hwang Zung Tse(黄化之), Member of the Shanghai Citizens'
Association.
Mr. Zung Tse Shing(陳子馨), Manager of the Hung Yuen Shing
Cotton Firm, Yang S Ching, Pootung.
Mr. Chih Hai San(成海珊), Manager of the Feng Kee Cotton
Shop, Lane 340, No. 38 Avenue Edward VII.
Mr. Pan Tse Wen(潘志文), Manager of the Hung Shing Cotton
Firm, Yang Ching Village, Pootung.
On October 8 and 9, 1937, this Society sent a number of
its agents to Nanwei, Chuensha, King San and Sungkiang Hsiens
to collect raw cotton from the framers.

（左侧手写批注：file / J.R. / 15/10）
（左侧印章：S.M.P. / SPECIAL BRANCH / 1937）

S.1. 特别股
报告
日期：1937年10月14日
事由：浦东棉花运销协会。
呈报人：华探员 施子良 (Sih Tse-liang) 转呈人....................

浦东棉花运销协会于1937年10月3日正式成立（参见附上的1937年10月4日《每日情报报告》摘录），其办事处设在爱多亚路 (Avenue Edward VII) 1454号浦东同乡会内。该协会的主要宗旨是规范浦东地区农民从田间收集的棉花的销售。值得注意的是，由于目前的战事，对该商品的需求已大幅减少，导致浦东农民的生计受到严重影响。
该协会决定筹集1,000,000.00元作为资本，分为1,000股，每股1,000.00元，截至目前，其成员已认购其中的800,000.00元，成员人数约三十人，均为浦东的棉商或士绅。
以下人员为常务委员会委员：-
杜月笙 (Tu Yueh Sung) 先生，上海市民协会会长。
黄化之 (Hwang Zung Tse) 先生，上海市民协会会员。
陈子馨 (Zung Tse Shing) 先生，浦东杨思 (Yang S Ching) 宏源盛 (Hung Yuen Shing) 花行经理。
成海珊 (Chih Hai San) 先生，爱多亚路38号340弄丰记 (Feng Kee) 花店经理。
潘志文 (Pan Tse Wen) 先生，浦东杨泾村 (Yang Ching Village) 宏盛 (Hung Shing) 花行经理。
1937年10月8日和9日，该协会派遣多名代理人前往南汇、川沙、金山和松江县，向农民收购原棉。

（左侧手写批注：档案 / J.R. / 10月15日）
（左侧印章：上海公共租界警务处 / 特别股 / 1937）

Extract from Daily Intelligence Report dated 4/10/37
Cotton Transportation and Sales Society of
Footung - new body formed

A new organization entitled the "Cotton
Transportation and Sales Society of Footung"
(浦東棉花運銷協會) came into existence on
October 3 at a meeting held in the Footung Guild,
1454 Avenue Edward VII, when some thirty-six
Chinese were present. Efforts are being made to find
an office for the Society.
